settingsAi.heading: AI settings
settingsAi.description: Choose the default provider and override models per action. Translation and summaries always use Cloudflare.
settingsAi.defaultProviderDesc: Used for actions except translate and summarize.
settingsAi.cloudflareDesc: Fast defaults; translation/summarize stay on Cloudflare.
settingsAi.cfModelsDesc: Used for translate/summarize and when Cloudflare is the provider.
settingsAi.orModelsDesc: Used when OpenRouter is the provider.

fix.label: Fix grammar
fix.description: Corrects grammar, spelling, and punctuation while preserving tone.

shorten.label: Make shorter
shorten.description: Condenses the selected text without losing meaning.

continue.label: Continue writing
continue.description: Continues from the cursor while preserving tone.

translate.label: Translate
translate.description: Translates the selected text into another language.

ask.label: Ask AI
ask.description: Responds to an instruction or question.
